metaTitle: P.L.A.W for parents, players and managers — see what happens at practice
metaDescription: One code from the coach opens your player's practices: which drills, how long, and what is planned next. The history stays in your own account.
heroTitle: Know what really happened at practice.
heroSubtitle: Your coach sends you a code. From that moment you see every tennis practice the player does — which drills, how long, and what is planned for the days ahead. No questions after training, no waiting for an answer.
howTitle: Three steps and you are in
howSubtitle: Nothing to install and nothing to set up — it runs in your phone's browser.

steps.title: Create an account
steps.body: Sign up and pick who you are — player, parent or manager. The rights are the same; only the label differs.

steps.title: Enter the coach's code
steps.body: Your coach sends you a short access code. You enter it once and that connects you to your player.

steps.title: Just watch
steps.body: Practices show up on their own, as the coach logs them. You fill in nothing.

showcaseTitle: This is what it looks like
showcaseSubtitle: The whole app is built for the phone — check in whenever and wherever you are.
showcaseNote: The calendar and analytics are part of the subscription.
featuresTitle: What you see about your player

features.title: The practice list
features.description: Logged and planned, newest first. A month filter finds any practice, even two seasons back.

features.title: Every practice in detail
features.description: Which drills were done, how long the session ran and what the coach noted. You also see which drill was skipped or replaced.

features.title: Calendar
features.description: Weekly and monthly view. One look at what the training week looks like.

features.title: Analytics
features.description: How much time went into which focus area, how that changes over time, and two periods side by side.

features.title: A history that stays yours
features.description: The records live in your account as your own copy. They do not disappear when the work with the coach ends.

features.title: Read-only
features.description: You cannot break anything and you do not touch the coach's work. The app is a window for you, not a form.

transparencyTitle: The training log belongs to you too, not only to your coach.
transparencyIntro: This is what P.L.A.W promises you:
transparencyQuote: The whole practice history stays in your account — including the sessions your player has done with the coach you work with today. Nothing is sent anywhere and nothing is deleted. If your paths part, you can let a new coach look through it any time, right there with you.
transparencyNote: A coach who is not afraid to put the record of their work into the client's hands is a true professional.
pricingTrial: 14 days to try, then it is paid.
pricingFree: The practice list and every practice detail are yours without a subscription — the subscription adds the calendar and analytics.
pricingOnePlayer: Following two children needs two accounts for now.
finalCtaTitle: Got a code from your coach?
finalCtaSubtitle: Sign in or create an account and start following practices.
guideCta: Read the guide for players, parents and managers
coachText: Are you a coach looking for an app of your own?
footerTagline: P.L.A.W — the training log that stays yours
